payout_transferred_fields.name: payout_transferred_fields
payout_transferred_fields.value: "payout_requests"."status"<>'transferred' OR ("payout_requests"."method"='stripe' AND "payout_requests"."stripe_transfer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_requests"."encrypted_receipt" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_requests"."paid_date" IS NOT NULL)

payout_paid_fields.name: payout_paid_fields
payout_paid_fields.value: "payout_requests"."status" <> 'paid' OR ("payout_requests"."encrypted_receipt" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_requests"."reference_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_requests"."paid_date" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_requests"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL)
